designationHistory.name: Tinicum National Environmental Center
designationHistory.indexText: Congress directed the Secretary of the Interior to establish the Tinicum National Environmental Center, to protect the last true tidal marsh in Pennsylvania, as a unit of the National Wildlife Refuge System, in Public Law 92-326.
designationHistory.note: Signer inferred from the date (Nixon was President in June 1972). The FWS file includes Public Law 102-154 (Nov. 13, 1991), the Interior appropriations act associated with the later renaming for Senator John Heinz; the renaming wording was not read here.
